gspot 0.1.0 · [Source definition](https://github.com/stefanionescu/gspot/blob/main/presets/tool/xcode/manifest.toml)

Checks that every line of a build settings file is a setting, an include, or a comment.

## Why

Xcode ignores a line it cannot read, so a typo turns a setting off without a word.

## What to do

Write the line as a name, an equals sign, and a value.

## Where it runs

- Preset: [the xcode preset](/reference/presets/xcode/)
- Stage: commit
- Level: recommended
- Engine: integrity

Turn it off for a path with a reason: `gspot ignore xcode/xcconfig --paths <glob> --reason "<why>"`.
